label: TP
reason: User-controlled parameter names flow directly to Writer.format() without sanitization. The switch statement uses 'C' (hardcoded from 'ABC'), ensuring param always reaches bar. Parameter names from getParameterNames() are user-controllable via URL/query parameters and can contain XSS payloads through URL encoding.

evidence.note: Source: user-provided parameter names from request.getParameterNames()
Switch target is always 'C' (from 'ABC'.charAt(2)), assigning param to bar
Sink: bar written to response via Writer.format() without encoding/sanitization
